verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents its own contract-creation capability (a no-code builder and templates) and native e-signature, so a founder could generate and sign agreements from templates rather than drafting from scratch. Nothing in the evidence mentions SAFEs, convertible notes, or standard financing terms. The only hint of 'industry standard' templates is a 2015 community question, not a feature description. Missing for 10: any evidence of SAFE or convertible-note templates, evidence of standard (e.g. YC SAFE) terms, a founder or fundraising workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate and sign SAFEs or convertible notes on standard terms without drafting from scratch
